messages:
Olivia Chen: kicking off config-only canary for routing+batching tweak, 10% traffic, change window 18:00-19:00 UTC. pinned model version rdl-3.1 for this canary.

deploy-bot: CONFIG-DEPLOY started by Olivia Chen (canary=10%, env=prod, change=routing/batching). check /deploys/1749955555 for logs.

Sanjay Rao: watching p50/p95 and error-rate dashboards. I’ll set an alert for >0.3% errors and p95 > 450ms.

Maya Torres: config payload below. batch.target=8, batch.max_wait_ms=25, per_route_timeout_ms=800, routing_policy=latency_preferred, soft_rate_limit=150rps:

```json
{
  "batching": {"target": 8, "max_wait_ms": 25},
  "timeouts": {"per_route_ms": 800},
  "routing": {"policy": "latency_preferred", "fallback": "cost_preferred"},
  "rate_limits": {"soft_rps": 150}
}
```

Olivia Chen: exact plan: 10% -> monitor 10m -> 33% -> monitor 20m -> full. If errors or latency regressions, we rollback to previous routing policy and batch.target=4.

Ben Park: agreed. add quick rollback rule: if total error rate across canary nodes > 0.5% for two consecutive 1m windows, auto-rollback. Also, if p95 increases by >20% vs baseline for 5m, pause rollout.

Sanjay Rao: deployed canary slice, metrics streaming now. p50 120ms, p95 390ms, errors 0.12% — green so far.

deploy-bot: METRICS: canary_slice=10%, p95=402ms, errors=0.82% -> threshold breach (error > 0.5%). Initiating rollback candidate alert.

Olivia Chen: hold on automated rollback, give me logs for the spike. could be a bad cache miss or transient infra flake.

Sanjay Rao: scanning logs, filtered sample: 
```
[2025-05-12T18:05:12Z] upstream_cache: GET key=kv:user:xyz status=503 region=ap-south
[2025-05-12T18:05:13Z] inference_runtime: call_id=abc123 latency=420ms error=null
```
Looks like redis 503s in ap-south causing upstream timeouts and cascading retries. Only ~3 nodes in canary in that region.

Maya Torres: suggestion: narrow rollback to routing policy only for ap-south and keep canary elsewhere. We can pin ap-south to safe-routing-v1 and keep batch.target=8 globally.

Ben Park: +1 for targeted rollback. reduces blast radius. If we see similar infra noise elsewhere, we do full rollback.

Olivia Chen: doing targeted routing rollback for ap-south now. deploy-bot, apply pin safe-routing-v1 to region ap-south for this canary slice.

deploy-bot: ACTION: pin routing=safe-routing-v1 for region=ap-south on canary=1749955555. Rolling change applied.

Sanjay Rao: metrics after pin: p95 overall 410ms -> ap-south errors dropped to 0.18%, global errors 0.22%. Looks stabilized.

Olivia Chen: ok, continuing rollout. advance to 33% in 10m. note for release notes: "Config-only: routing policy tuning, increased batching defaults; targeted rollback exercised in ap-south due to cache 503s."

Maya Torres: added checklist item to the change-window doc: "ensure region-specific rollbacks are possible and pre-approved by oncall" :white_check_mark:

Ben Park: +:thumbsup: Good run. Follow-up: open ticket to investigate ap-south cache health and put guardrails to avoid 503 cascades.

deploy-bot: DEPLOY-COMPLETE: canary advanced to 33% (1749955555). audit_id=deploy-audit-8971.

Olivia Chen: adding postmortem note to release channel with details and ticket references. Thanks all. :rocket:
